title: 10 Plumbing Tips Every Homeowner Should Know

shots.subject: kitchen sink faucet dripping water
shots.narration: You clicked on this video because something in your house is dripping

shots.subject: plumber working under kitchen sink with wrench
shots.narration: tired of paying someone two hundred dollars an hour

shots.subject: clogged drain in bathroom sink with standing water
shots.narration: Let us start with the one I get called out for more than anything else clogged drains

shots.subject: chemical drain cleaner bottle being poured into drain
shots.narration: They reach for that bottle of chemical drain cleaner

shots.subject: drain snake tool being inserted into bathroom drain
shots.narration: What you want instead is a simple drain snake

shots.subject: hair and debris pulled from drain clog
shots.narration: you are going to pull out a clump of hair and soap scum

shots.subject: large water heater tank in basement utility room
shots.narration: Your water heater that big tank sitting in your basement

shots.subject: water heater drain valve with garden hose attached
shots.narration: There is a little valve on the bottom called the drain valve

shots.subject: sediment and rusty water draining from water heater
shots.narration: Sediment builds up in there minerals from your water supply

shots.subject: garden hose flushing water heater outdoors
shots.narration: Hook up a garden hose open the valve let it run

shots.subject: main water shutoff valve in basement near meter
shots.narration: Know where your main water shutoff valve is

shots.subject: burst pipe spraying water inside house flooding
shots.narration: water is spraying everywhere the ceiling is coming down

shots.subject: hand turning water shutoff valve to off position
shots.narration: walk to the shutoff valve and turn it off

shots.subject: water damage on ceiling with peeling paint and stains
shots.narration: save you ten twenty even fifty thousand dollars in water damage

shots.subject: wrench tightening pipe fitting under sink
shots.narration: Overtightening people think tighter means better

shots.subject: cracked PVC pipe fitting leaking water
shots.narration: overtightening is one of the fastest ways to crack a fitting

shots.subject: plumber hand tightening pipe fitting gently with wrench
shots.narration: Hand-tight then a quarter turn with a wrench

shots.subject: teflon tape being wrapped around pipe thread
shots.narration: Teflon tape that thin white stuff you wrap around pipe threads

shots.subject: close up pipe threads with white plumbers tape wrapped correctly
shots.narration: Wrap it clockwise three or four times keep it tight

shots.subject: toilet tank interior with flapper valve and flush mechanism
shots.narration: Fixing a running toilet the problem is the flapper

shots.subject: hand replacing rubber toilet flapper in tank
shots.narration: You can replace one in about five minutes for less than ten dollars

shots.subject: cleaning toilet flush valve seat with sandpaper
shots.narration: Take some fine sandpaper and smooth that surface out

shots.subject: mesh drain screen strainer over shower drain
shots.narration: Mesh drain screens they cost about two dollars each

shots.subject: hand cleaning hair from drain screen strainer
shots.narration: I clean mine out once a week takes about ten seconds

shots.subject: P-trap curved pipe under bathroom sink
shots.narration: Every drain has a curved pipe underneath called a P-trap

shots.subject: running water from faucet into sink drain
shots.narration: Just run the water for about thirty seconds every month

shots.subject: garbage disposal unit under kitchen sink
shots.narration: Know what you can and cannot put down a garbage disposal

shots.subject: pouring cooking grease into kitchen sink drain
shots.narration: Grease coats the inside of your pipes and hardens

shots.subject: potato peels in kitchen sink near garbage disposal
shots.narration: Potato peels turn into a starchy paste that gums up the blades

shots.subject: cold water running from kitchen faucet
shots.narration: always run cold water while the disposal is running

shots.subject: taking photo of plumbing pipes with smartphone
shots.narration: Before you start any plumbing project take a picture with your phone

shots.subject: person working under kitchen sink with pipe connections visible
shots.narration: when you are elbow deep under a sink your memory is not as good

shots.subject: plumber tools wrench tape on workbench
shots.narration: Ten tips from twenty-five years of crawling under houses
